item.title: Access in and out of alleyway, 21st August
item.description:
Hi there, we’ve been having more and more issues regarding access in and out of the alleyway. I personally have issues where I can’t get in or out of the alleyway with my car and trailer or even sometimes my big van due to how vehicles park where circled in the pictures. Neibours have had building work done and we can’t receive deliveries by Lorrie’s because of inconsiderate parked cars and recently we had a small fire and a fire engine couldn’t gain access again due to the parked cars. In the pictures it’s mostly where the white van is parked. For me to get in the alley I need to drive where they are parked otherwise my trailer will hit the vehicles and won’t fit in the alley due to the turning angle. Ideally we need yellow lines where the van is parked. When the other yellow lines where added we was told they will be done as well but they still haven’t been done. Please cane we have this resolved as this has stopped me more than once getting my trailer out which I earn money from doing recoveries or collections and just caused many other issues too. Thanks Scott 187 Parkside avenue

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Parkside Cross, Barnehurst, Greater London
